$comment: SEEDED FROM WHAT SHIPS, NOT FROM WHAT THE DESIGN IMAGINES.
labels as a CLOSED TWO-VALUE ENUM on
It does NOT emit namespaced+versioned ids. So each registry entry carries `wire_labels`:
the label a service actually puts on the wire today, mapped to the registry id.
That mapping is what keeps this file from becoming another unmaintained mirror:
check-population-registry.mjs asserts the mapping is TOTAL and INJECTIVE against the
pinned ISL artifact in BOTH directions. The day ISL adds a third label, CI here fails.
Metric assignment is ISL's, read from src/utils/response_builder.py PRE_NOISE_METRICS /

wire_label_sources.note: Every value at this pointer must map to exactly one population id below, and every id declaring a label for this source must appear at the pointer.

transforms.description: Adds 1.0x the model std per outcome/risk sample (~sqrt(2) spread inflation). Independent draw PER OPTION, which is why it breaks Common-Random-Numbers alignment for joint metrics. Default-OFF since 2026-07-26 (ISL ENABLE_AUTO_SCALED_NOISE).

populations.description: Monte-Carlo samples drawn from the structural model alone, with no post-hoc noise term. Common-Random-Numbers aligned across options.
populations.note: The five metrics above are ALWAYS on this population regardless of the noise flag (ISL PRE_NOISE_METRICS). When auto_scaled_noise_applied is false the POST_NOISE_METRICS land here too.

populations.description: Model-only samples with the auto-scaled noise term added. Marginal distribution metrics only — never the joint CRN metrics.
populations.note: ISL POST_NOISE_METRICS. Labelled noise_inflated only when auto_scaled_noise_applied is true; otherwise these metrics report olumi.mc.model_only@1.

$comment: Deliberately EMPTY. The design's `conditioned` and `intervened` stages have no
producer today. Pre-registering ids nobody emits is exactly the non-adoption
failure this scaffolding exists to prevent — an id enters this registry in the
same change train as the producer that emits it, with an adoption-manifest row.
